item.text:
Further improved [open_addressing_linear_probing.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/015_open_addressing_linear_probing/open_addressing_linear_probing.java) by separating the implementation into an idiomatic core `OpenAddressingIntMap` and a compatibility wrapper `hashMap`. The core now uses primitive `int[]`/`byte[]` arrays with explicit slot states instead of allocating an object per entry, which simplifies the hot path and reduces overhead.

I also added clearer primary methods that don’t overload `-1` as both a valid value and a “not found” signal: `putValue`, `getValue`, and `removeValue` return boxed `Integer` values, while the legacy `get`, `remove`, `deleteNode`, and `insertNode` methods still work through the wrapper. Verification passed with `javac open_addressing_linear_probing.java && java hashMap`, plus an extra check covering stored `-1` values, missing-key behavior, repeated removals, and reinsertion after tombstones.
